es.title: Liderar la IA no es contar PRs
es.desc: Leí una receta en seis pasos para que los directivos se suban a la IA ya. Comparto la urgencia, pero no la forma de medirla. Lo que haría yo.

en.title: Leading AI isn't counting PRs
en.desc: I read a six-step recipe for leaders to get on board with AI right now. I share the urgency, but not the way it measures success. Here's what I'd do.
